title: National Rail Museum, New Delhi

terrainReference.basis: Unaltered terrain sampled at the Qualla story pin inside the outdoor museum.

mapIdentity.provider: Native museum boundary, individual building footprints, preserved tracks, visitor rail alignments and the turntable from OpenStreetMap.
mapIdentity.scope: The native museum boundary contains the exact octagonal indoor gallery footprint, Rail Cafeteria and four service buildings. Four approximate canopy spans sit over native sidings. The track network and native turntable ring and center locate the surviving outdoor gallery and turntable.

note: Five exact Qualla CC0 photos establish open-sided, curved corrugated roofs, metal supports, rail ballast and adjacent paved strips. The National Rail Museum and Ministry of Culture identify the indoor and outdoor galleries and the turntable. Building cross sections, exact canopy dimensions and the fixed bridge are estimated.
